parameter.label: Calendar
parameter.tooltip: Calendar ID; blank uses the default.

parameter.label: Start
parameter.tooltip: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 datetime with an offset. A date alone means that day's opening.

parameter.label: End
parameter.tooltip: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 datetime with an offset. A date alone means that day's opening.

result.name: Minutes
result.tooltip: business_hours_between only: working minutes between the two moments (negative if End is before Start).

result.name: Hours
result.tooltip: business_hours_between only: the same as decimal hours, rounded to 2 places.

result.name: Calendar Fallback
result.tooltip: true when the requested calendar was not found and the default was used.

parameter.label: Operation
parameter.tooltip: add_duration, is_business_day, next_business_day, previous_business_day, business_days_between, business_hours_between, is_business_time or next_business_opening

parameter.label: Calendar
parameter.tooltip: Business calendar submission ID. Blank uses the default calendar; an unknown ID uses the default with a warning.

parameter.label: Date
parameter.tooltip: YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO 8601 datetime with an offset (converted to the calendar time zone). The from date, start or moment. In business-hours operations a date alone means that day's opening.

parameter.label: End Date
parameter.tooltip: business_days_between / business_hours_between only: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 datetime.

parameter.label: Amount
parameter.tooltip: add_duration only: negative reverses the direction. Whole numbers, except business_hours, which allows decimals (1.5 = 90 minutes).

parameter.label: Unit
parameter.tooltip: add_duration only: business_days, calendar_days, weeks or business_hours.

parameter.label: Direction
parameter.tooltip: add_duration only: after (default) or before.

parameter.label: Adjust
parameter.tooltip: add_duration only: none (default), previous_business_day or next_business_day. Ignored for business_hours.

parameter.label: Time
parameter.tooltip: Optional HH:MM overriding the calendar Default Activation Hour on business-day results.

parameter.label: Minutes
parameter.tooltip: business_hours_between only: working minutes between the two moments (negative if End is before Start).
